turns.question: How big was our customer base in Turkey at the end of September 2026?
turns.answer: Turkey's customer base at the end of September 2026 is 5 customers on "Customers to date" (everyone who had signed up by 30 September 2026, a running total over all time); for the same month, 1 customer signed up in Turkey in September 2026 (Signups) and 2 Turkish customers had a non-cancelled order in September 2026 (Active customers). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
